posts.title: Worker health and safety awareness in four steps
posts.summary: Free ministry training that meets Ontario's basic worker awareness requirement, with a printable certificate.

posts.title: Supervisor health and safety awareness in five steps
posts.summary: Free ministry training for anyone who directs work, meeting Ontario's supervisor awareness requirement.

posts.title: IHSA free health and safety resources
posts.summary: Free safety talks, manual chapters and templates from Ontario's construction safety association.

posts.title: Job Bank training finder
posts.summary: Search free and paid training programs across Canada by occupation, location and keyword.

posts.title: Habitat for Humanity Quebec volunteer intake
posts.summary: Sign up to help build and repair homes in Quebec — useful site hours for a construction or safety resume.

posts.title: Project Coordinator, Co-op (Toronto)
posts.summary: Toronto project-coordinator co-op for students who want estimating, RFIs and site-support experience.

posts.title: YMCA Ottawa Power of Trades
posts.org: YMCA of the National Capital Region
posts.summary: If you qualify, this Ottawa program can include First Aid, CPR-C, WHMIS and Working at Heights at no cost.

posts.title: WSPS free eCourses for Ontario workplaces
posts.summary: No-cost online courses such as WHMIS, OHSA awareness, inspections, lockout and incident investigation. A free account is required.

posts.title: Junior Estimator (Ottawa ICI)
posts.summary: Early-career ICI estimating role in Ottawa, $60,000–$80,000. One to three years or co-op experience counts; Reliability Status is required.

posts.title: HS&E Advisor (Ottawa, telecom projects)
posts.summary: Ottawa health and safety advisor role on telecommunications projects. An OHS certificate or diploma and three years' experience are expected; CRSP, CSO or NCSO is an asset. Pay range $71,200–$97,900.

posts.title: Habitat for Humanity Greater Ottawa build volunteer
posts.summary: Help build homes in Ottawa (including the Nantes site in Orleans). No experience needed; shifts run Tuesday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., and co-op students are welcome.

posts.title: CCOHS free awareness courses
posts.summary: Free short awareness courses such as The Business Case for Health and Safety and Being a Mindful Employee. These ones do not include a certificate.

posts.title: Bluebeam Academic Program
posts.summary: Free Bluebeam Revu access for students and educators in construction programs — a standard tool for drawings and takeoff.

posts.title: Health and Safety Coordinator (Ottawa)
posts.summary: Ottawa construction safety coordinator role. NCSO and about three to five years of construction safety experience are listed as requirements.

posts.title: Procore Construction Academy
posts.summary: Free self-paced courses on RFIs, submittals, daily logs, budgets and construction-management basics. Finished courses can go on a resume or LinkedIn profile.

posts.title: Workplace Safety North free mental health e-learning
posts.summary: Five new one-hour mental health courses, including peer support and leadership's role, free until December 31, 2026.
